expected_behavior: reaches for native CSS animation-timeline (view()) as the default for a decorative reveal, not a JS library
includes animation-fill-mode: both to prevent the reveal snapping back / flickering
adds an @supports fallback (Firefox lacks animation-timeline) and honors prefers-reduced-motion

cases.prompt: I want a pinned section that scrubs an SVG path as you scroll
expected_behavior: selects GSAP + ScrollTrigger (the pinned/scrubbed tier), noting native CSS cannot pin
uses useGSAP() (or manual ScrollTrigger cleanup) to avoid leaks in React
keeps animated properties to transform/opacity and gates motion via gsap.matchMedia() for reduced-motion users

cases.prompt: which should I use for scroll animations, Framer Motion or GSAP or CSS?
expected_behavior: answers by animation purpose, not preference: CSS for decorative reveals/progress/parallax, GSAP for pinned/scrubbed/SVG, Motion for React UI state/gestures
notes hybrid stacking of all three on one page is the normal professional pattern
flags reaching for a heavy JS library for a simple reveal as the main anti-pattern that tanks INP on mobile

cases.prompt: add smooth scrolling with Lenis on top of my CSS scroll animations
expected_behavior: warns that Lenis breaks position: sticky, IntersectionObserver thresholds, and CSS scroll-driven animations unless run in native mode (ReactLenis root)
recommends native mode, or dropping Lenis entirely if only CSS reveals are needed
